notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - RELEASE DATE SET
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png

Hey everyone

This will be the final development update post, as I can now announce the release date for Galactic Mining Corp!

First up, over the last few weeks I have worked on squashing over 200 bugs and issues identified by my amazing team of testers who have spent collectively thousands of hours playing the game through over and over again. In particular, I'd like to thank my good pal RetroSteezy for his incredible dedication to meticulously pulling apart my game over hundreds of hours of playtime - cheers, mate! :D

Alongside all this bug fixing has been more polishing and some late-game balancing, which has been both difficult and time-consuming, but important to the overall experience. In my last update I told you that Lana_Lux had voiced Kira, the tutorial bot. She is now joined by Galactic Mining Corp's character artist, Peet Cooper, as the voice of Hogan the hangar dude. And of course, I am voicing the dodgy market seller slime alien. My thanks go to both Lana and Peet for helping bring those two characters to life.

But anyway, now onto the bit you've been waiting for. As many of you know, one of my gamedev heroes is Shigeru Miyamoto and I think one of his past quotes sums up my feelings on Galactic Mining Corp: A delayed game is eventually good. A bad game is bad forever. Galactic Mining Corp has been in development for close to two years and represents the largest investment of time I have made in any of my seven games to date. However, as I have said in the Kickstarter and the various updates, I truly believe it has been worth it. Thank you all for your patience with the release date announcement, and so with that...

Galactic Mining Corp officially releases on Tuesday 18th May 2021.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/8410cc57aee6cde44ff1e389071ce3596bbae4a8.jpg

For those of you who pledged in the "New Recruit" or higher Kickstarter reward tiers, details of fulfilment applicable to each tier will be posted prior to release.

I'll finish with another big thank you to everyone for their amazing support and helping me to bring the full Galactic Mining Corp vision into reality.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #13
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png

Happy New Year!

It's a brand new year and I am really pleased to report that all of the crew members and HQ rooms are now finished and have been integrated into the game. Most of the artwork is now also done, with a few remaining larger static pieces for the Investment Sites still to go. I am growing the GMC universe every day with the backer content and it is shaping up really nicely.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/cc72c37a9c56a3eab8858a00f4f7ce7f88259498.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/8b2f0ace7682846baf22f1a6f9ece3b4dcd39255.png

Further to extensive feedback from alpha testers, it became clear that the additional fourth galaxy was skewing the progression and spacing out the game content too far to be enjoyable. For this reason, I have decided to axe the fourth galaxy and re-structure things - the number of planets and locations will be the same, but in three galaxies rather than four. At the time the stretch goal of the fourth galaxy was created it was not anticipated that play would be negatively impacted, but this is part of the development process and we have to learn from it and respond accordingly - I don't want it to spoil the game, but rest assured that the actual content that would have been in the fourth galaxy is not being axed.

Over the next few weeks I will be addressing a number of bugs from the alpha testers and getting fixes integrated ahead of the release candidate testing. I will also be finalising those remaining Investment Site art pieces and polishing up the last bits of content.

I'll wrap up this update with some very exciting news: Based on current timeline, I expect to finish development of the game by around March 2021, with the intention to release it soon after. We're so very nearly there and I am doing my best to get it to you as soon as possible. I will make a full announcement regarding the release date in the next 6-8 weeks or so.

See you in the next update!

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #12
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png
Hey everyone

For those of you who have been tuning into my Twitch livestreams, you will have seen some great progress over the last few weeks. I am really pleased to tell you that all of the HQ rooms are now complete, as are most of the backer content rewards. HQ rooms include saunas, dark matter reactors, meditation gardens, and even an animal rescue centre. Here are some more examples of the new rooms you can build in your HQ building:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/f449c8d4b8dd640b382f5b1aeaac95fd61b74c1a.png

Peet has been also working tirelessly on the crew character portraits, which have turned out beyond amazing. From fire-breathing space giraffe to a smug 1980s business guy who loves showing people his watch, there has been a huge variety of wacky crew lining up to join your mining corporation once you complete their in-game crew contract! Here are some of the latest additions to the crew roster:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/facfd2e54af9f943aabc6db364744249ce1593a7.png

These have been some really important milestones that I was really determined to hit before Christmas and I am very happy to achieved them. Going into the new year, I have some of the larger individual art pieces such as the Investment Sites to work on, and then lots more testing and polishing ahead of release. I also have some cool announcements coming up about collaboration and cross-over with other game universes which I hope you'll find as exciting as I do... stay tuned for more.

In closing, I wish you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. See you in 2021!

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love, 
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #11
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png

This update is a little different to my previous ones, but it's both important and deserving of a little context - I have decided to change the name of the game to "Galactic Mining Corp". I'm in the process of making the name change across all media platforms effective Tuesday 1st December. Please rest assured that the game is staying the same as has been promised - it is only the name that is changing (and not really by much).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/0250cf4d5c3fc41195f63b228830d0885c8149e7.png

"OK Windy, that's great, but WHY?" I hear you scream. First and foremost as time has gone by and development has progressed, it has become clear to me that the game is more than a sequel. It is Geo's successor in nearly every aspect, from the significant improvements in art and music, through to new gameplay elements and player experiences. As I consider the totality of the game, it is a standalone work in its own right - there is also no need to have played the original Geo in order to get the most out of this game.

Secondly, each game a developer releases is being thrown into a very busy, crowded marketplace full of messages from content producers such as myself. It's very difficult to get visibility and when you do, you usually just get one shot at capturing someone's interest. "Geo" doesn't mean much on its own and I am frequently asked what the original game is about. By changing to "Galactic Mining Corp", it instantly tells players what sort of gaming experience lies ahead of them - you're in space, you're mining, and you're running a business. I ran the name change past some friends, industry professionals, and players of my games - the response was as clear as it was positive - it is a much better name.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/dd6d894f41c41c042d1aec26dba4609ab2a90a40.png

And finally, over the course of releasing half a dozen commercial games, I consider myself to be more experienced and, hopefully, more professional in my approach. Being an indie developer in a crowded bazaar of gaming and entertainment offerings means that changes such as this can be inevitable - it's moving with the ebbs and flows of what people are looking for, better understanding not only what but also how they search for, access, and enjoy new content and experiences. The change in name should lead people more directly and more clearly towards the game.

This journey, made possible by the generous support of my wonderful Kickstarter backers, has been about making the game the best it can be. The extra time to enhance the art, game mechanics, and content will really make it shine, and with the name changing to Galactic Mining Corp, I hope it will bring in even more players to share that experience with you.

During this transition to a new name there may be changes to how Geo 2/ Galactic Mining Corp is found and handled by Steam. Certain aspects of this change have to be handled by Steam themselves so this process is ongoing. Hopefully this slight turbulence won't last long and I will keep you updated along the way.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #10
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone!

As we reach the end of November, it has been a very intense few weeks here at the studio. There has been lots of testing and refinements on systems and mechanics across the whole of Geo 2. From tweaking progression in the Coretrium to adjusting the fine-grained stats for drills and bonuses, a huge amount of effort has gone in to get things balanced so that you have the most enjoyable experience when mining for your galactic fortunes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/b786d58889b26e40780868c30098f6bdc4019be5.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/47b71b596e30485b0075504ba11733db5e55402c.jpg

We know that players love being able to show off their skills and determination, so there are now over 100 unlockable achievements going into the game to track and celebrate your progress! There are a wide variety of achievements, with simple goals as well more challenging ones for the most demanding of gamers.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/e64397fa6828e5f2be4a8f821a540af74c93bf07.jpg

We now move into December where work continues on the content and art for Geo 2. In particular, Peet and I will be focusing on the remaining Kickstarter backer content rewards. Most of the planets, items, and space traffic are now complete - we have got some wild and wacky stuff in there! For those backers in the VP Human Resources reward tier, Peet has already reached out to most of you regarding your character designs and we have seen some incredible suggestions being brought to life. I can't wait to see these crew in the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/73cf654183db1198be3e6fac475d71ec041be76c.jpg

As the temperatures plummet here in the UK and winter settles in, over the next couple of months the game will get its remaining sets of art assets, data content, mechanics tweaks, and final polish. There will also be an updated game trailer coming soon, showcasing many of the improvements. It has been a long road for Geo 2, but I believe the end result will be well worth it. It's a game that I will be immensely proud of and one which I hope will bring an enormous amount of enjoyment to you and all the backers - it couldn't have got to this level without you.

You can still find me regularly streaming game development and art over on Twitch, please do drop by if you'd like a look at how it's all coming together - I'd love to see you there.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube


Expect another update and exciting sneak peeks before Christmas.

Much love,
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #9
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone

So much has happened with both Geo 2 and my other games since the last update. Rest assured I am working on Geo 2 every single day and doing my very best to make Geo 2 the sequel to remember! So enough words Windybeard, tell me what you have done!

Effects and Polish
Now this is one of my favourite stages of a games development. Now that I am fast approaching the later stages of development I have been replacing, updating and polishing everything that needs it. Little tweaks to explosions, small visual effects, colour changes and rearranging things that didn't quite feel right. The list of these small jobs is too long to list here but after several weeks of this the game has leapt forward in terms of quality. Below are a few screenies that show some of these updates and effects.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/314ebc227a164acf312c450370d856c185af3070.png

Caves and variety
I have started ramping up the variety and events you can find while drilling. One of my intents with Geo 2 is to give you all the sense of never really knowing what to expect when drilling toward the core. Even after many hours of play I want you to find new things to interact with, run from and even laugh at. I have added lots of new “cave events” to find. These are small random things you can find, some help you, some don't but they are never negative. There are common ones and rare ones. The rare “cave events” can be super useful. Here is a fun one to have a peep at.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/e3edcc7521aa2d7c0c8a35f467700d35fd5500e4.gif

Kickstarter art
For the Geo 2 Kickstarter I offered backers the opportunity to purchase different assets in the game such as rooms, planets and even crew members. Here are some of the new assets I designed based on the awesome ideas of the Kickstarter backers. It was awesome to see how creative people can be and some of the ideas were genuinely amusing. Here are some of the planets the crazy Kickstarter backers came up with!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/8b39d49e209501cd7ab64bb2b29fe41fb9aab6e2.png

Bugs smashing
As with the polish stage I detailed above, I have now moved head first into the pulsating belly of the bug beast. Every little annoyance, every little mistake or bug is being chronicled and obliterated. Its a challenging, often annoying but very satisfying part of late stage development. Still a few to go but its really starting to come together now.

Puzzle Plunder Vampire Night DLC
As some of you have seen I have released a Vampire themed expansion DLC for my FREE to play match 3 game Puzzle Plunder. Puzzle Plunder Vampire Nights is out now so if you fancy checking it out please do so.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1445800/Puzzle_Plunder__Vampire_Night/

Halloween Sale
Every game of mine is currently heavilly discounted for the Steam Halloween sale! Upto 75% off everything. Check them out and if you fancy grabbing one then I would appreciate that very much.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6139/Windybeard_Complete_Collection/

Thanks again for the ongoing support for Geo 2 and all my other games. It really is appreciated! Also while I have you here, please consider leaving a short review for any of my games if you own them and even if you dont own them, consider leaving a short review for another indie developer. They mean so much and are often a glimmer of light in the ever swelling waves of Steams algorithmic uncertainties.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Thanks for reading!

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #8
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone

There has been loads of great stuff happening with Geo 2 over the past few weeks. Heres whats been going down in grove town!

Kickstarter
As you may have seen the Geo 2 Kickstarter was a roaring success! It was fully funded in under 5 hours and finished at around 250% funded, achieving 2 stretch goals! This means that Geo 2 will now have an extra galaxy to explore, there will be hidden arcade mini games to find and play in the galaxy maps that will unlock cool stuff and thirdly you will be able to send nano drills off to bring you resources!! Wooo!

A big part of the Kickstarter campaign was to allow people to put their own stamp on the universe by designing planets, rooms, investment sites and more. I am now getting back the information from the amazing backers as to what they would like and OH MY MY... we have some awesomely weird and wonderful things going into the Geo 2 universe! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/109c8ed84c891a68ae9b97afb0859ebc86e1ebd6.png

Enviroment art
At the top of every planet in Geo 2 is a nice slither of art, the ground level of that planet. I have been furiously designing these assets and I absolutely love drawing alien landscapes. There will be a ton of variety throughout the planets and hopefully these will help build that feeling of descending into a strange alien planet. Here is a few of the designs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/81683d3df087aa248207abb2354e0cf61f8272e8.png

Drills
I have now designed all of the drill components for Geo 2. As you play through the game you will unlock new drill heads and drill bodies. These are interchangeable so you can build a drill that best suits your play style! Each has its own stats that can be upgraded and all the components have their own strengths and weaknesses.

Each drill piece was designed in a large version for the HQ and the Garage and also a smaller animated one for when you are drilling and scooting about in space. The graphics change depending on your choice. Additionally each drill body has its own coloured trail when you fly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/8b6d486d82246c39342972bb632a03607e6285e3.png

Arcades
As stated above there are now arcade mini games to find throughout the universe. If you can beat certain high scores you will unlock some really cool prizes (like the changable HQ backgrounds)
The first game is “Mr Banihans Banana Drama”. As with Geo 2 itself the game is played entirely with the mouse. Left click to shoot and right click to change lanes. Avoid the evil vegetable monsters and drop off bananas for points!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/74ea15025155b543c85b45eceadfe05cda8e2eea.png

UI/HQ Update
A large job I recently completed was to modify every single UI and the entire HQ with damage, marks, scuffs and patches. It was a large undertaking but one I feel gives the entire game a much more “industrial” vibe. An intergalactic mining corporation run by strange aliens wouldn't be pristine and well kept now would it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/1f1c1c6bb140dcbd89ee51ddb63d837690192d55.jpg

Whats next? I have a lot of art to do! I am chipping away at the mountain as fast as I can and rest assured, Geo 2 will be here soon and it will be all the better for all this extra work.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Thanks for reading!

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone

Its been a good few weeks since the last update however please be assured I am working endlessly on Geo 2 to make it the best game It can be. Here is some new stuff!

HQ Customisation
AS you play through Geo 2 you will be able to increase the size of your HQ which allows you to build more rooms, you will also be able to unlock different locations to have your HQ such as an arctic tundra or a volcanic cliff top. There will be many more of these to unlock as you play through the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/1c235f86fbf103915eeb3bd57f737628460d4545.gif


Crates
As you drill you will find crates which contain special power-ups and abilities. When the game starts you can only find a handful of these crates however as you explore space you will recover stock for the market place, one of the main stock types you will find are new power-up crates. Buying these from the store will unlock the crate and it will begin to appear at random throughout the games drilling sites. Here are a few of the crates you can find. (There will be LOTS of crates to unlock)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/83abdef026a55b3418aa00ebf41ba6880b3a530f.png

Kira - Tutorial
Meet “Kira” your new and improved Geo assistant robot.  She will guide you through setting up your Business and step you through some of the basics when you first start playing. She can also be called at anytime from the help menu and explain in detail the many aspects of the game and for those who go in deep with the game she will break down some of the advanced techniques and mathematics behind the games systems.

For those who dont like tutorials she can be just told to go away and you can figure it all out for yourself.

She isn't finished just yet but will be soon,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/c3f985f84f5e7ad8696e04636e597fe17a349946.png

Sound and music
While I cannot show this in a image or Gif I can tell you that most of the music and sound is now in place and it is great! Injekted (Dude who does all the Windybeard music) has outdone himself with this OST.  32 unique, smooth chillout DnB for you to drill too! If you played Geo 1 then expect that OST but on a whole new level! The OST will also be available as a DLC and will have full soundtrack plus album edits of each track for a total of 64 tracks!

Kickstarter
This is still in the process of being finalised, When it launches (Hopefully very soon) I will give you plenty of notice to jump in and check it out. There will be some great ways to support the game and place your own stamp on many aspects of the game from designing planets to crafting your own crew members!

Other Stuff
Outside of all this I have been working on less exciting aspects of the game such as bug fixing, balance and content data entry. While not explosively entertaining it is amazing to sit back and see the progress on Geo 2 and I can tell you now that if you enjoyed Geo 1 then you are going to love Geo 2!

I am honoured to have a very talented artist PEET involved and assisting with Geo 2. He is super talented and has worked on some of the greatest games in the world! He is designing the characters for Geo 2 (and some other cool stuff). Check out this image he is currently working on for Geo 2! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/b50f5e904c0c39287c70457bdf3ec04ade3e19a6.png

Thank you all so much for reading and your patience with Geo 2's development. It will be released soon I promise!

10% of sales of Geo 2 will go to the gaming charity "Gamers For Good".
https://gamersforgood.com/ 

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #6
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone

Geo 2 development is pressing ahead nicely . Since the last update a large amount of art work has been completed. Pretty much 2 weeks of solid art and design.

Tiles
Last update I spoke about the tile designs and my progress (72 tiles completed) I have now completed all 120 tile designs for Geo 2 WOOHOO. Its a massive content milestone and I am happy with how they turned out. Its no easy feat to design 120 unique tiles that are interesting and colourful. Here is 6 more tiles to look at!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/5e955c1e752dbdb1c945ed76c3a452b9a1714319.png

Points of interest
I have also completed the design of a few new “points of interest” scenes. I showed an unfinished design last update so here is that scene finished. I really enjoy the process of making these POI's and hope to have some really interesting locations to find and funny stories to enjoy that will really make the Geo 2 universe feel alive and full of fun.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/5fe973a2b04248e0c5a5417fec166945000f1a4c.png

Geo 2 Headquarters (HQ)
I have been designing the actual Geo 2 HQ building. When you upgade your HQ in the coretrium it grows in size by 2 rooms. Each level of the HQ is hand designed and builds up a unique and interesting building like no other. Here is the current piece I am working on (Lvl 8 HQ)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/98f96165c53fed3f27dc074bce90e887a083037f.png

Options
Outside of the vast amount of art work being completed I have been working through a truly huge “to do” list of tiny features, quality of life changes and all round game play tweaks to make Geo 2 more fun, accessible and pleasant to play. This includes options to removed screen shake, reduce particle and effects, provide visual cash drop values and damage counters etc and much more. There will plenty of options available for you to tailor Geo 2 to your own tastes and needs. I am eager to hear of any options that would help you enjoy Geo 2.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/0d9d4b15a7f89f2acc6ab075f90649cbfc2ea446.png

Kickstarter
I am currently building a small Kickstarter campaign to raise a little funding to push Geo 2 that bit further. Geo 2 will be released regardless of the campaigns success however if I can get the small campaign successful it will really help push Geo 2 further and make it even better! Watch this space for more info on this when the time comes and I hope I can count on your support!
Not only will you be able to pre order a copy of Geo 2, there will be tons of cool backer rewards up for grabs and some really great ways to get involved with aspects of the game and put your stamp on it!

Physical Stuff
I am also in the process of creating and designing some awesome physical Geo 2 stuff. Its very early days however It is something that is in the works and I hope its gonna be awesome. I will again update you all with their progress and when the time comes how you can get your hands on these exclusive Geo 2 (and other Windybeard) physical products.

Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are looking forward to Geo 2.

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #5
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png

Hey everyone

Lots of work has been happening with Geo 2. Most of this work is lots of tiny modifications and bug fixing. One of the biggest changes since the last update was the new Geo 2 Logo. Below you can see both the new and old Logo designs.

New logo
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/9be40e274e484d7714d5cc09247c07f52cd86965.png

Tiles
I have also been designing many of the tiles that will fill the worlds in Geo 2. At the time of writing this I have completed 72 Tiles. I plan to have a huge assortment of tiles to bring a great variety to the worlds you drill. Each tile has its own stats and information and every single tile can be leveled up in Geo 2. Leveling up a tile will increase its cash value by 50% and also award you with a "Drill Token" each time it is leveled up. You can use those drill tokens to upgrade your drill components. Here is a few of my favourite tiles!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/4b92c83f2a97b9f857206651630e8f92817d00d4.png

Monsters
I have also been designing and adding new monsters. In Geo 1 monsters appeared randomly throughout the drill sites. In Geo 2 monster appearance is slightly different. They will still appear randomly throughout the planets however they are preset to specific planets. For example the Giant worm may only appear on certain planets instead of all of them. This allows me to create far more variety and hopefully some fun and amusing surprises.
Many of the monsters have returned from Geo 1 (BONSON!!!) and many more new ones. Here is one of the many new monsters. This guy is called "Bloat"

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/414b4b767234161093a660ad8500bb9f56e85ead.gif

Points of interest
One of the new additions to Geo 2 is the "Point of interest" (POI) that you can find when exploring space. These are bonus locations. They show a hand drawn image of the place you have found, some story and a prize. This has allowed me to really work some more story and Lore into the expansive universe of Geo 2. They are great fun to design however they do take a while to finish. I hope you like them and I think they will add a great depth to the game that was missing from the original.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/929af7b884effcf323ff8f834d10142bdf95bc7c.png

Here is the current POI I am working on. Alien desert Storage

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/053173778a5ed0482ce1ebfaf7f242884e75dfc3.png

Dev Tools
One of the hardest jobs for me when making this game is actually building the universe and balancing the content within it. There are so many different variables involved with every aspect of the game and one of my most important principles with Geo is to allow the player to explore in any direction they want and deal with the consiquences of that choice. This is a very difficult balancing issue however I am confident I can get it right and make a fun, well balanced yet challenging universe to explore and enjoy.

here is a little sneak peak at the Location database I have built to actually create the planets you drill in the game. Its not pretty but it does the job. There is most likely a large amount of additional data points I will need to add to this tool before its finished.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/7e79ac96351e2efbe9f2ade85d8a976df86d4291.png

A huge amount of art still is yet to be completed for Geo 2 however it is coming along really well and I am happy with its development so far. I will post more incomplete art works and stuff like that as I really dig into this huge art phase. Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are looking forward to playing Geo 2.

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #4
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/ad8338ad5765d2bc282e529a4d8e8cbc458bc338.png

Hey everyone

In this update I will explain the many ways in which you can progress and upgrade almost every thing in the game. One of the main game play aspects of Geo 2 is the freedom to choose how and when you level up whatever you wish to upgrade. The choice is yours and those choices are never wrong. Every upgrade helps in some way or another.

Last week I went into detail about the drilling system in Geo 2 and in order for you to successfully drill planets and make money you need to become stronger and more resilient to the many forces at play trying to stop you achieving this. In short you will always want to increase your stats!

Basic Stats
There are a boat load of stats to manipulate in Geo 2 however you have a small set of base stats that are key to progression. These stats are always shown to you in the top left of the screen, you can toggle this on and off if you want to. The stats are as follows...

 Drill Power - This is the amount of damage you will do to a tile when drilling it
 Drill HP - This is the amount of Hit Points/Health your drill has
 Crit Strike - This is the amount of extra damage you will do when a critical hits
 Resistances - Fire, Ice, Acid, Radiation and Dark. These are your resistances to elemental damage received when drilling affected locations.

Also shown in the top left is...


 Cash - How much money you have
 Core fragments - How many core fragments you have, spend these in the Coretrium perk tree
 Drill Tokens - These are required to upgrade drill components
 Geo level - Your overall level. This goes up with every bit of progress you make.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/57a9dc5e267d44c542950af6bda8833b9db06002.png

Upgrades
There are a huge number of ways you can increase your stats. The most important being building up your HQ. At the start of the game your HQ will consist of a little building with 2 vacant rooms. Luckily you are also given 2 room blueprints so you can build these in the vacant rooms. Each room has its own specific stats that when built are instantly added to yours.

The rooms stats mirror your own so you can see exactly what stat increases you are getting when the room is built. There are 2 further key bits of information to note "Crew slots" across the bottom, and "Crew Xp Modifier"

Each room allows you to place up to 4 crew members into that room, when adding crew members you will add their stats to the room stats and ultimately to your drill stats. Building rooms and adding crew members is how you get ahead. Crew members and rooms can be unlocked throughout the game and I will touch further on this in a later update. When crew members are in a room they will receive XP from drilling and the "Crew Xp Modifier" shows you how much XP they will get, in this instance they will receive and extra 20% XP! BONUS!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/5801385639a9035a67ad58c5e50b3c149fd5a5d5.png

Crew Upgrades
As explained above crew members gain XP from drilling. Having crew members not assigned to rooms means they will not receive XP at all. When a crew member is stuffed full of XP they can be upgraded via the crew menu. What is important to note is that crew bonus stats unlocked through this process are added to your stats FOREVER regardless if the crew is in a room or not! These are incredibly important and upgrading crew members will make you very powerful.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/8fc5149ffd53f6d5993a53eb5464c76692af76f6.png

Room Upgrades
Every room can also be upgraded 3 times. These upgrades do not give you stat boosts however they do permanently increase your cash multiplier. Once upgraded the cash multiplier boost is applied regardless if the room is built in the HQ or not.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/7f480e861970778021ed98c6e89e124013973dd2.png

Collection
When you drill tiles or collect items in Geo 2 they are recorded and kept. Every single block you drill is yours and has many different ways of helping you progress. One such way is by upgrading the Tiles and items themselves. Each tile has a XP requirement and can be upgraded 3 times. When a Tile is upgraded its value when drilled increases by 50%. So a tile worth 10 gold will now be worth 15 gold! Not only does it increase in value but you will also obtain a "Drill Token". Drill Tokens can be spent upgrading the drill many drill components you find throughout the game. I will explain more about the drill customisations and upgrading in a later Update.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/f05ab441bf4e0b57e320e759cfcaf612dd8e20b9.png

Coretrium
The coretrium is by far the most important thing to upgrade in Geo 2. It is the very core (Pun intended) aspect of your success. Every planet you drill has a core, smash that core open to get core fragments. These fragments can be spent inside the "Coretrium" to unlock huge perks. These perks are percentage based and are applied over your normal stats. Things like "+10% to drill power", these are huge upgrades.
Also in the coretrium are 2 special nodes.
HQ Uprade - Will increase the size of your HQ by 2 additional rooms
Galaxy Map - Will unlock an entire new additional galaxy map to explore

As you can see these are very very important upgrades and should always be your priority.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/3ad544a9073d3024d1acf916beb471550fc4ae92.png

Geo Level
Your "Geo lv" is your overall progression level. Every thing you do in Geo will grant you Geo Xp, drilling a planet core, upgrading a crew member, exploring space, upgrading a tile and much more. Every little upgrade will add xp to your Geo level. When this is ready to upgrade it will flash and clicking on it will level you up and provide you with great rewards.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/41baa09fb422285079d6d1f2be7be289956f127e.gif

There are many other little upgrades and ways to progress in Geo 2 that you will find as you play the game and every single upgrade no matter how small will help you progress further. Get ready to upgrade like you have never upgraded before!

Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 update - 23/09/2019
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Geo 2 is really starting to come together. Many of the original systems are back and already working in the game and I have started work on some crazy new mechanics and concepts that will make Geo 2 a blast!

One of my biggest aims with Geo 2 is to make the entire process of leveling everything up far more intuitive. Offering the player the most appropriate information when they will need it, all housed in hand drawn unique interfaces. Alongside this I will be making sure the drilling section of the game houses an almost endless stream of crazy unexpected events and cool stuff to find.

Another big part of Geo 2 is hiring crew members. Here is a small fraction of the crazy crew you can employ in Geo 2! Fans of the original Geo will recognise a few upgraded characters. Geo 2 will be releasing early 2020!

Be sure to follow me on Twitch for live development and all round good times! 

https://www.twitch.tv/windybeardgames

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943092/22267339f87be89e7f9cbbab97c699d8586bf241.png

notes.title: Sweezy Gunner - Challenge Mode - UPDATE RELEASED!
notes.content:
The Sweezy Gunner Challenge Mode has landed. Prepare yourself as these challenges are not for the faint hearted! 

The objective is simple, collect the blue "Challenge Coins" and get to the exit pad within the time limit to complete the challenge. However it is not that simple, how does 1 slice of health and a buzzilion monsters sound!!!!

Do you have what it takes?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5RLiBJiP-Jg

--------------------------------Update includes--------------------------------
Challenge Mode
 28 intense Challenge maps
 1 New zone type - The Oblivion Shard
 3 New monsters
 1 New Soundtrack (Oblivion Shard)
 4 New Steam Achievements

Fixes and updates
 Start Button is now "New Game"
AZERTY keyboard Support
 Directional key support
 Player options are now saved
 Dash skill revised - To dash you hold the Shift key and press the desired direction to dash, no more accidents!
 Full Screen from startup
 Skills now explained in the pause menu
 Several little bug fixes
